identity.title: Retain Simple Preprocess Tool Partial after concrete owner audit

origin.summary: The user requested that Partial refactoring continue in scheduled cycles and that each remaining Partial be structurally reviewed rather than mechanically deleted or split.

state.current_summary: SimplePreprocessToolWpfView.xaml.cs를 no-change 구조 감사로 재확인했다. View Partial은 required XAML/composition adapter로 유지되고, parameter controller/text presenter/preview executor/property factory/document factory/base가 editor state, presentation, algorithm, persistence, creation, lifetime을 각각 소유한다. 독립 state/lifetime/test seam이 없어 production split은 만들지 않았으며, Debug/Release contract/build와 Simple Preprocess WPF smoke가 통과했다.

objective.summary: Audit SimplePreprocessToolWpfView's Partial structure and retain it only if existing concrete owners already provide the required parameter, preview, signal, persistence, binding, and lifetime boundaries without a new split.
constraints: Work only in C:\Git\2D\Dev; do not modify C:\Git\2D\Original.
Do not add a service, interface, manager, wrapper, forwarding Partial, or ViewModel split for file length alone.
Preserve SimplePreprocessToolWpfView XAML names, parameter facade, Learn action, preview path, signal evidence, settings callback, and DisposeView lifetime.
Keep test outputs and evidence under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev.
Do not commit, push, tag, release, deploy, or mutate the Original repository.

criteria.text: The proof report records current/intended owners, caller path, mutable-state writer, lifetime owner, binding/public/test contract, shortest reading order, and the reason no production split is justified.

The source contract proves that the View Partial has no direct persistence/file-dialog/algorithm-construction coupling and that existing parameter, presentation, property, preview, document, registry, and base lifetime owners are wired.
Focused Debug/Release contracts and builds plus relevant WPF smoke and dynamic monitor geometry pass; broader theme/DPI/input/camera/SDK/GPU/native runtime remains explicitly unverified.

evidence.observation: SimplePreprocessToolWpfView remains a required XAML/composition adapter. Existing parameter controller, text presenter, property factory, preview executor, document factory, registry, and base View provide concrete editor, presentation, property, algorithm/result, persistence/creation, registration, and lifetime owners. The View has no direct settings store, file dialog, System.IO, OpenCvSharp, or algorithm construction coupling.
SimplePreprocessPartialBoundaryContract passed 9/9 in Debug and Release. VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke Debug and Release builds passed with exit code 0.

PipelineViewerScreenshotSmoke Debug build passed with exit code 0. WPF precheck passed wpf_shell_host_rotate_scale_tool, wpf_simple_preprocess_result_review, and wpf_simple_preprocess_tool_learn_button with check=OK and layout/text/internal counts zero. Sequential monitor probes for Rotate/Scale and result review each passed with one DISPLAY2 1920x1080 monitor and one intersecting visible window. Broader UI and native matrices remain unverified.

events.summary: SimplePreprocessToolWpfView Partial은 required XAML/composition adapter이고 기존 parameter/presentation/property/preview/document/base owners가 독립 책임과 lifetime을 이미 제공한다. 새 seam 없이 분리하면 wrapper나 중복 상태가 되므로 no-change로 유지한다.
PL-0042의 세 completion criteria가 현재 증거로 충족되어 resolved로 닫는다. 전체 theme/DPI/input, camera/SDK/GPU 및 long-running native runtime은 이 slice의 검증 범위가 아니다.

The Simple Preprocess Partial retained-owner audit found no independent boundary that justified a production split; focused source/build/WPF evidence was recorded. Do not reopen without a new requirement, reproducible defect, failed criterion, or changed dependency/lifetime boundary.
